name: Kling 3.0 (Image to Video)
description: Kling 3.0 image-to-video from a first frame (optional end frame), with optional native audio.

type.description: element: a multi-image element registered from `frontal_image_url` and `reference_image_urls`; the prompt references it as @id.
type.title: Type

frontal_image_url.description: Frontal image of the subject (type element): jpg/png, <=10MB, >=300px, aspect between 1:2.5 and 2.5:1.
frontal_image_url.title: Frontal Image Url

reference_image_urls.description: 1-3 additional views of the same subject (type element): jpg/png, <=10MB, >=300px, aspect between 1:2.5 and 2.5:1.
reference_image_urls.title: Reference Image Urls

type.description: preset_element: an element from Kling's preset library named by `element_id`; the prompt references it as @id.
type.title: Type

element_id.description: Id of an element in Kling's preset library (type preset_element).
element_id.title: Element Id

type.description: video_element: a video-character element registered from `video_url`; the prompt references it as @id.
type.title: Type

video_url.description: One mp4/mov of a realistic person (type video_element), 3-8s, 1080p, 16:9 or 9:16, <=200MB. Speech in the clip becomes the element's voice.
video_url.title: Video Url

image_url.description: URL of the first-frame image to animate.
image_url.title: Image Url

last_frame_url.description: URL of an optional end frame.
last_frame_url.title: Last Frame Url

elements.description: Up to 3 inline or preset elements to place in the scene.
elements.title: Elements

multi_shot.description: Allow multi-shot output from a shot-scripted prompt.
multi_shot.title: Multi Shot
